description: Source code implementing audio sink helper functions and test environment classes for audio frame buffering and playback control in the starboard/nplb namespace.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers
classes.description: Manages audio frame buffers for testing, supporting different sample and storage types.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
classes.description: Simulates an audio sink environment for testing audio playback, buffering, and callback handling.

methods.name: GetAnySupportedSampleType
methods.description: Returns a supported audio sample type, preferring deprecated int16 if supported, otherwise float32.

methods.name: GetAnySupportedFrameStorageType
methods.description: Returns a supported audio frame storage type, preferring interleaved if supported, otherwise planar.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes buffer sizes based on supported audio formats.

methods.name: AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers
methods.description: Constructors for setting up audio frame buffers with various configurations.

methods.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
methods.description: Constructor and destructor managing the lifecycle of the audio sink for testing.

methods.name: SetIsPlaying
methods.description: Sets the playing state of the test environment.

methods.name: AppendFrame
methods.description: Appends frames to the buffer in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: GetFrameBufferFreeSpaceInFrames
methods.description: Returns available free space in the frame buffer.

methods.name: WaitUntilUpdateStatusCalled
methods.description: Waits until the source status update callback is invoked.

methods.name: WaitUntilSomeFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until some frames are consumed.

methods.name: WaitUntilAllFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until all frames are consumed, appending silence if needed.

methods.name: OnUpdateSourceStatus
methods.description: Handles source status updates, updating internal counters and signaling condition variables.

methods.name: OnConsumeFrames
methods.description: Handles frame consumption callback, updating internal counters.

methods.name: UpdateSourceStatusFunc
methods.description: Static callback function for source status updates.

methods.name: ConsumeFramesFunc
methods.description: Static callback function for frame consumption.
